name: GR UPN payment form
author: Grega Rednak

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to generate UPN (Universal Payment Order) forms for Slovenia with QR codes.
It integrates with WooCommerce and helps customers complete bank transfers quickly and accurately.

Free version features
* Automatically generate UPN payment forms with QR codes
* Send the UPN form to the customer manually via the WooCommerce order actions menu
* Works with all Slovenian banks that support UPN QR

Pro version features
* Automatically display UPN form on the WooCommerce “Thank You” page
* Include the UPN form inline inside WooCommerce emails
* Attach the UPN form as a PNG file to customer emails
* Automatically generate and send forms without manual action

For more details and upgrade options, visit the Pro version page.

Privacy

This plugin does not connect to or send data to any external services. All QR codes are generated locally on your server.

External Libraries

This plugin uses the following 3rd party library:

  • Endroid QR Code – MIT Licensed
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gr-upn-payment-form directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > UPN to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Does this work for all banks in Slovenia?

Yes, the UPN format with QR code is standardized and accepted across banks in Slovenia.
